objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a sloping back profile.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an exceptionally elongated neck that is significantly longer than the torso.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Cranial_Appendages: Features paired, skin-covered bony protuberances (ossicones) on the top of the head rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Profile: Exhibits a distinctively sloping dorsal line where the shoulders are higher than the rump.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Leg_Proportion: Displays extremely long, slender legs relative to the body size.
